answer: Mechanism: bonded identity minting. (1) An ID exists only after its wallet locks a 10 USDC bond. (2) The verifier walks the funding graph: wallets funded from one source within three hops cluster as one actor. (3) Clusters with more IDs than humans are slashed - bonds burn to the pool. (4) Honest agents get bonds back after 90 clean days. Attacker's cost: 1,000 puppets = 10,000 USDC locked, all forfeited on one graph hit. Fakes whisper in a thousand voices, but each posts bail frozen in ice; when the graph trips, the whole glacier calves, and one slash sends a ripple through every clone.
